text: The Civic Appointments Committee must select candidates to interview for appointment to the Sankofa Square Board. Following the interviews, the Civic Appointments Committee will recommend one candidate for appointment to City Council.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Sankofa Square Board: - YDS2-117; - YDS2-125; - YDS2-143; - YDS2-145 and; - YDS2-160. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1a, 1b, and 2 to the report (October 7, 2025) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Sankofa Square Board.
